categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: (1) Resource-based comprehensive utilization products, including FCC catalysts, regenerated catalysts, and molecular sieves; (2) Hazardous waste treatment and disposal services, including waste catalyst processing and high-sulfur petroleum coke hydrogen production slag comprehensive utilization; and (3) Industrial waste gas treatment services using proprietary non-ammonia reduction technology. The company also develops waste plastic recycling and chemical recovery businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include: (1) Solid waste catalyst resource utilization technology; (2) High-sulfur petroleum coke hydrogen production slag comprehensive utilization technology; (3) Industrial flue gas non-ammonia reduction desulfurization and denitrification technology; (4) Industrial waste sulfuric acid chemical chain recycling technology; (5) Salt-containing wastewater reuse technology; and (6) Mixed waste plastic deep catalytic cracking technology (CPDCC). These technologies enable one-step conversion of mixed waste plastics into high-value products and resource recovery from industrial waste streams.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major petroleum refining enterprises, particularly China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) which accounts for 61.02% of 2024 sales. The company serves the refining and petrochemical industry, with specific focus on FCC catalyst users and enterprises generating hazardous waste. Key end markets include petroleum refining, petrochemical processing, and waste resource recovery sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates across multiple regions in China including Qingdao (headquarters and main production facilities in Huangdao District), Jiangxi Province (Jiujiang operations), Guangdong Province (Jieyang operations for petroleum coke slag utilization), and Xinjiang (waste plastic recovery operations). The company also has international operations through its subsidiary Forland Petrochemical Technology LLC and exports catalysts and related products to overseas markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the supply chain: (1) Upstream/midstream: waste collection and processing of industrial waste catalysts, petroleum coke slag, and waste plastics; (2) Midstream: resource recovery and catalyst regeneration; (3) Downstream: production and sales of regenerated catalysts, molecular sieves, and chemical products. The company integrates waste treatment with resource recovery and product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Advancing waste plastic deep catalytic cracking technology with a 200,000 ton/year demonstration project under construction; (2) Expanding petroleum coke slag comprehensive utilization capabilities; (3) Developing non-ammonia reduction flue gas treatment technology for broader market adoption; (4) Pursuing international market expansion for catalysts and additives; (5) Establishing waste plastic collection and recycling networks; and (6) Developing high-purity vanadium products and energy storage materials from waste streams.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Product sales of regenerated catalysts, molecular sieves, and chemical products (34.03% of 2024 revenue); (2) Hazardous waste treatment and disposal services (57.73% of 2024 revenue); (3) Industrial waste gas treatment services (4.79% of 2024 revenue); and (4) Other products and services (3.45% of 2024 revenue). Revenue is recognized upon customer acceptance of products or completion of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company operates in a competitive catalyst and waste treatment industry. While specific competitors are not named in detail, the report indicates intense market competition with declining catalyst prices and waste treatment fees. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, particularly in petroleum coke slag utilization where it operates China's first and only comparable facility for Guangdong Petrochemical. The company holds a strong position in hazardous waste treatment with multiple operating licenses across regions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized environmental technology enterprise with 2024 revenue of 1,149.18 million yuan (7.33% growth from 2023's 1,070.65 million yuan). Total assets reached 4,938.90 million yuan at year-end 2024 (50.32% increase from 2023). However, net profit declined 69.24% to 42.60 million yuan in 2024 from 138.51 million yuan in 2023, primarily due to margin compression in catalyst business and increased operating costs from new project ramp-up.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key differentiators include: (1) Proprietary waste catalyst resource utilization technology creating a virtuous cycle of waste treatment and catalyst sales; (2) China's first and only operational high-sulfur petroleum coke slag comprehensive utilization facility, providing unique solutions for Guangdong Petrochemical; (3) Innovative non-ammonia reduction flue gas treatment technology addressing environmental concerns with traditional ammonia-based methods; (4) Advanced mixed waste plastic deep catalytic cracking technology enabling direct conversion to high-value chemical products; and (5) Integrated waste-to-resource business model reducing environmental impact while creating economic value.
